text.en: Taking a quiet evening after that post. Thanks for checking in — what helps you unwind?
text.fr: Je prends une soirée tranquille après cette publication. Merci de prendre des nouvelles — qu’est-ce qui t’aide à décompresser ?

text.en: A walk and a few pages helped me slow down. Do you have a favourite quiet spot?
text.fr: Une balade et quelques pages m’ont aidé à ralentir. Tu as un endroit calme préféré ?

requestText.demo-request-in: Busy days can still feel lonely. Would you like to say hello?
requestText.demo-request-out: I connected with your post about being understood. Happy to start with a hello.

greeting.en: Hey! How has your day been?
greeting.fr: Salut ! Comment s’est passée ta journée ?
